name: The Things Network
tagline: Global community LoRaWAN network for low-power IoT device uplink and downlink
description: The Things Network (TTN) is a global community LoRaWAN network that connects low-power sensors and devices through shared gateways. Developers use application-layer integrations (HTTP webhooks, MQTT, Storage API) on The Things Stack to receive uplinks, send downlinks, and manage end devices. Community coverage is free; enterprise and cloud offerings come from The Things Industries.

auth.details: API key (Bearer token) from the Application Console; used as Authorization: Bearer NNSXS... for Storage API and as webhook secret or MQTT credentials depending on integration

pricing.free_tier_limits: Community network free for fair-use LoRaWAN traffic; Storage Integration limited retention; paid plans via The Things Industries Cloud/Enterprise — exact API request quotas not published as a simple free-tier number
pricing.paid_plans: The Things Industries Cloud and Enterprise for managed/private stacks

rate_limits: not published as a single public API quota; Fair Use Policy applies to community network airtime and infrastructure
use_cases: receive LoRaWAN sensor uplink payloads via HTTP webhook
send downlink commands to end devices
query recent device uplinks from Storage Integration API
list and manage application end devices via Network Server API
subscribe to live device traffic over MQTT
